# frozen_string_literal: true

require "set"

module Robot
  class Error < StandardError; end
  Point = Struct.new(:x, :y, keyword_init: true)

  class Base
    attr_reader :name
    def initialize(name: "r") = @name = name
    def each(&block) = [1, 2].each(&block)
    def to_s = "#{self.class}(#{name})"
  end

  def self.solve(input)
    case input
    in { x: Integer => x, y: Integer => y } then Point.new(x:, y:)
    in [first, *rest] then rest
    else nil
    end
  rescue Error => e
    warn e.message
  ensure
    puts <<~TXT
      done
    TXT
  end

  private_constant :Error
end

%w[a b].map(&:upcase).each_with_index { |s, i| p(s => i) }
x = ->(a, b = 1, *c, d:, **e) { [a, b, c, d, e] }
x.(1, d: 2) if __FILE__ == $PROGRAM_NAME
